# Coppermind (`bonjoski/coppermind`)

> Local-first AI memory system that gives your coding agents persistent, searchable, tamper-evident memory across sessions—with zero cloud dependencies.

- Core stack: Pure-Go SQLite WAL (Profile A) or optional PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector / Redis (Profile B), MCP STDIO/SSE server, hybrid vector/BM25 search, lightweight knowledge graph, working scratchpad, signed `.capsule` cartridges, and Stormcage prompt-injection/secret quarantine.

## Paved-Road Integration (`2026-11-22`: Mentor Capsules, PO Requirements & `BLPR-v1`)
- Passive ideation mentor & PO requirements: `coppermind recall --lens mentor [--json]`, `coppermind requirements [--triggers ...] [--json]`, `coppermind distill`
- MCP (`UB-MCP-v1` & `BLPR-v1`): `coppermind_recall` supports `session_id` + `emit_receipt` to atomically write signed `ideation` `BLPR-v1` DSSE receipts under `FABRIAL_RECEIPT_DIR` (linking `CONJOINER_SIR_ID` lineage) and returns `UB-MCP-v1` `structuredContent` (`exit_code: 10`) on quarantine/policy denials.
